scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && cd client && npm install --include=dev && cd ../server && npm install --include=dev
scripts.build: cd client && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
